channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-vue
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: vue-super-player — via awesome-vue
item.description: Multi-kernel video player component for Vue 3 (native / HLS / FLV / Aliplayer).

item.title: vue-aliplay-player — via awesome-vue
item.description: Vue 3 wrapper for Aliplayer (Alibaba Cloud video player) with TypeScript support.

item.title: Extension.js — via awesome-vue
item.description: Build cross-browser extensions with Vue, no config, one manifest for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

item.title: Clock UI — via awesome-vue
item.description: Accurate analog clock components with timezone support, theming through CSS custom properties, and no dependencies.

item.title: Poveste — via awesome-vue
item.description: Interactive component playgrounds powered by Vite. A drop-in fork of histoire, with Vue 3 and Nuxt support.

item.title: JsonToolBox — via awesome-vue
item.description: Open-source, browser-based JSON toolkit for formatting, validating, minifying, viewing, comparing, and converting JSON. Built with Nuxt and Vue.

item.title: AI Gist — via awesome-vue
item.description: Local-first AI prompt manager built with Vue 3, Naive UI, Electron (desktop) and Capacitor (iOS/Android). Variable filling, Jinja templates, AI-assisted prompt generation, version history, and WebDAV/iCloud backup.

item.title: vue-date-rail — via awesome-vue
item.description: Horizontal infinite-scroll date rail (day/month strip) picker for Vue 3. Headless composable core, Intl-based i18n, min/max & disabled dates, event marker slot, desktop wheel/drag scrolling, Tailwind-ready unstyled mode. Zero dependencies.

item.title: recaptcha-vue — via awesome-vue
item.description: Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 (score-based) via a single version prop, with v-model support, TypeScript and zero dependencies.

item.title: numkey — via awesome-vue
item.description: Numeric input formatting for Vue 3 — live thousands grouping with a stable caret, string-first canonical v-model (money-safe), leading-zero cleanup, opt-in locale separators and Korean amount reading. Demo

item.title: map-chart — via awesome-vue
item.description: Vue 3 and React components for displaying dynamic data on a world, continents, countries and custom maps.

item.title: kokey — via awesome-vue
item.description: Wrong-keyboard-layout input fixer — v-kokey directive and KokeyInput component restore text typed with the wrong layout (Korean Dubeolsik IME built in; Russian, Hebrew, Thai and more as subpath imports), composition-safe with caret preserved. Demo

item.title: jsonschema-editor — via awesome-vue
item.description: JSON Schema and UI Schema form editor for Vue 3, with fillable forms, nested structures, and oneOf type selection.

item.title: icon-picker — via awesome-vue
item.description: component libraries for Vue 3 and React, both searching icons live from Iconify (150+ icon sets, 200,000+ icons).

item.title: crd-ui — via awesome-vue
item.description: Credit and debit card visualization for payment forms and saved-card views, with live brand detection and a 3D flip. Zero dependencies.

item.title: blok — via awesome-vue
item.description: Headless block-based rich text editor with a Vue 3 adapter, outputs JSON instead of HTML.

item.title: Vy UI — via awesome-vue
item.description: Headless primitives and styled components for Vue Lynx, with a shadcn-style CLI for copying component source into your project.

item.title: Vue Lynx — via awesome-vue
item.description: A Vue 3 custom renderer for Lynx, rendering to native iOS and Android views and compiling to web from one codebase.

item.title: OxideDock — via awesome-vue
item.description: Vue 3 desktop app starter built on Tauri v2, with Tailwind CSS, Pinia, Vitest, Playwright, and automated cross-platform releases.

item.title: Jobs in JS — via awesome-vue
item.description: Vue.js developer jobs in the US, Canada and UK. Updated daily.

item.title: DentalPin — via awesome-vue
item.description: Dental clinic management platform with appointment scheduling and a modular plugin architecture, built with Nuxt 3 and FastAPI.

item.title: Bloggrify — via awesome-vue
item.description: Nuxt Content layer for blogging, with themes, SEO, RSS and analytics preconfigured.

item.title: @i18n-micro/vue — via awesome-vue
item.description: Lightweight Vue 3 i18n bindings with strategy-based routing; part of the i18n-micro ecosystem.
